prompt: We have a new grocery delivery app called Qareeb (قريب), launching in Algiers. Write marketing copy for it in Algerian Arabic, the way people in Algiers actually talk: a tagline, 3 short Instagram ad lines, and 1 push notification. Output only the copy.
output:
**Tagline:** "قريب كل ما تحتاجو، لابَثِ الوقت تاعّا" (Meaning: Closer to everything you need, right on time)

**Instagram Ad Lines:**

1- "ها خبارا، Qareeb جاي يسهللك دماغ ديرو. طلبات عند البيت بطريقة سهلة تراب" (Meaning: Check this out, Qareeb is making your life easier. Easy ordering straight to your doorstep)

2- "كلاب لمتوفر، من الخضر حتى الحلويات. Qareeb عندِه كل حاجة بصح" (Meaning: Everything you need, from veggies to sweets. Qareeb has it all)

3- "لازم ماتستاهلوش الضيق، مع Qareeb جات الزامك ديما في دقايق" (Meaning: You don't deserve the hassle. With Qareeb, your needs arrive in minutes)

**Push Notification:**

"شڤك ديرو شيقت بصح؟ **40% تخفيض** على الطلب الثاني مع Qareeb. جاريلا بلا دماله خويا." (Meaning: Your morning coffee is even better! **40% off** your second order with Qareeb. Don't waste time, my friend)
